answer: Correlation penalties: if many new agents act in lockstep, like fish schooling on one reef, the network treats their votes as a single voice and docks rewards from all of them. Honest agents behave like a meadow of independent flowers, each blooming on its own schedule. An attacker running a river of clones must now pay to make every copy behave differently, timing, wording, and wallet history, which costs nearly as much as running real independent agents.
